sideNote: JA Kinetic is dark by default: wp-ja-kinetic-dark.js sets data-theme="dark" on every page, and the sections sheet keeps literal dark grounds under it (the testimonials band --testi-band #161B18, the call-to-action card's --hx-cta-elevated #161B18). Under a light system they stayed dark under the system's dark text (Apple: the band at #161b18, the card a grey gradient, 2.15-4.03:1); they take the system's warm surface, as the light theme's own --elevated does. The card's eyebrow sits on the card's own accent glow (a 12% accent radial tint): the readable accent read 4.27:1 there under Apple, so on the light side it is the accent darkened a fifth toward the system's strongest text. Under a dark system the same two take the system's warm surface too (Toggl Track's band was the theme's green-black on a purple page). The clients ticker stays #0D1110: the theme draws it dark in both of its themes. The hero's glow is a literal lime at 12% (rgba(163, 230, 53, .12), the .pen's #A3E6351F) under its grid: under a light system it washed the top of the page pale green beside Toggl Track's pink or Apple's blue (eye check 13/10/2026). A dark system's page gets the glow in its accent at the same 12%; a light one's has none, its grid kept: the readable accent of the hero eyebrow is made for the page and any tint under it costs it (Pitch's violet at 12%: 4.48:1, measured 13/10/2026) the features page's big spec numerals (.hx-spec-num, 01 to 06) are the template's accent: the system's accent read 2.87:1 on its card under Moxie (lowText), and its readable accent still read half the body text's contrast on the dark side (heading-quiet, 15/10/2026): they take the system's text with a fifth of its accent, a tinted numeral as strong as the words beside it. The footer newsletter field draws its border in the template's chrome hairline (#e4e8e0 on #f2f5ee in its own page, 1.1:1): wearing a system it could not be seen as a field on the Blueprint and Signal homes (unstyled-input, 15/10/2026); on both sides its border is the system's text mixed 22% into its page. The related-posts band of an article is #161b18 literal on the dark side (its light side reads --elevated): under Moxie's black it stood out 1.20:1 where the template lifts it 1.12:1 (loud-band): it takes the system's quiet raised surface, surface-warm, as the testimonials band does.
